factual_claims.claim: More than 200 papers have been published in the last two years regarding adversarial attacks on machine learning systems.
Model inversion attacks can reconstruct faces from training data to the point where they can be identified with 95% accuracy by human workers.
Researchers successfully emulated a BigML model using 1,150 queries within 10 minutes.
In a medical dataset experiment, an 8% poisoning rate changed the predicted dosage of Warfarin by 75.06% for half of the patients.
Some popular models in the Caffe model repository lack SHA1 hash integrity checks, indicating potential for tampering.
